title: joserfc: Compact JWS size guard allocates attacker-controlled segments before rejection (CVE-2026-119284)
description: joserfc version range >=2.14.0_4 <2.15.0_5 has a vulnerability where the compact JWS size guard allocates attacker-controlled segments before rejecting them, causing unnecessary memory allocation. This occurs because the library calls bytes.split() on the input before validating its size, leading to a copy of the payload being made even if it will be rejected. The issue is fixed in version 2.15.0_5.
